turns.user_utterance: Help! I keep checking my account, but my refund is not showing. I requested that a seller refund my money a while back, but there is no money showing in my account. What can you do for me?
turns.assistant_response: Sorry you’re dealing with that. I can help you check why the refund hasn’t appeared—refunds can take time to be processed by the merchant and their bank. Can you tell me the refund date (roughly) and whether it was a card purchase or a transfer?
